{{Quote|I hate it here. Everyone uses me, insults me. I'm just garbage. I hate being scared all the time.|Anuli, regarding his existence on Nar Shaddaa|<ref name="TOR:TU">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|The Underdogs|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref>}}
'''Anuli''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] who served the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] underboss, [[Gele'ren]], during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Anuli and I grew up together on the streets. He's like my little brother.|[[Mako (slicer)|Mako]]|<ref name="TOR:TEoME" />}}
Anuli grew up alongside fellow slicer, [[Mako (slicer)|Mako]], who regarded him as her little brother.<ref name="TOR:TEoME" />

[[File:Anuli_dead.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Anuli assassinated]]
In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_dates" /> he assisted Mako's boss, the future [[Hunter (individual)|Grand Champion of the Great Hunt]], in eliminating the [[Eidolon (assassin)|Eidolon]],<ref name="TOR:TEoME" /><ref name="TOR:EB">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|Economic Boom|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref> but was killed by one of the Eidolon's [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droids]] before the hunter was able to save him, along with Gele'ren.<ref name="TOR:IE" />

Before Anuli was killed, he uploaded [[Eidolon Security]]'s private database records on to the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]], a severe blow to the company's business.<ref name="TOR:IE" />
